care_general.zh: 我注意到您好像遇到了很难的事情，您的安全对我们最重要。请随时联系酒店前台，我们就在您身边；如果您愿意，也可以拨打心理援助热线12385聊一聊，紧急情况请拨打120。
care_general.en: I notice something may be weighing on you, and your safety matters most to us. Please feel free to contact the hotel front desk at any time — we are right here for you. If you would like to talk, you can call the psychological support helpline 12385; in an emergency please call 120.

warm_suggest.zh: 听起来您最近有些辛苦。如果需要，我可以为您联系前台安排帮助，或者为您播放舒缓的音乐、调整房间灯光，希望您能好好休息一下。
warm_suggest.en: It sounds like things have been tough lately. If you would like, I can ask the front desk to arrange some support for you, or play calming music and adjust the room lighting — I hope you can get some good rest.
